o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *ček- (“to draw, pull”). Cognate with Crimean Tatar çekmek, Gagauz çekmää, Salar çik, Turkish çekmek and Turkmen çekmek. Compare also Chuvash шак (šak, “red lace applique on the back of a women's shirt”).
From sat + -qın. Cognate with Kazakh сатқын (satqın).
From Persian ملافه (malâfe), from Arabic مَلْحَفَة (malḥafa).
